discovery.summary: Bartleby renders a NeuronSphere repo's RST documentation (docs/) into HTML, PDF, and RevealJS slides using Sphinx-needs inside a Docker container, and can render standalone PlantUML diagrams to images. It ships two parallel implementations: a self-contained Go CLI (src/go/bartleby, distributed via Homebrew, no Python runtime needed) and the original hmd CLI Python plugin (src/python/hmd_cli_bartleby, invoked as 'hmd bartleby ...'). The Go CLI adds an 'explain' command that asks Claude to diagnose the last failed build.

entry_points.description: Go CLI root command: defines the 'bartleby' cobra app, its global flags, and how html/pdf/slides/puml/configure/explain/update-image subcommands are wired up.
Python hmd CLI plugin (Cement Controller) implementing the same html/pdf/slides/puml/configure/update_image subcommands as 'hmd bartleby ...'.
Install (Homebrew Go binary vs. Python plugin) and run instructions for both CLI implementations.
Index of Bartleby's NERD requirements docs (CLI, config, execution, gather, manifest, selection, sources, traceability).
